messages:
adele_cs: Quick sync — Vespera Health onboarding: observed ~45% token cost spike last Tue and p50 latency jitter spiking to ~320ms on their inference route. Renewal is in ~6 weeks and they mentioned cost concerns in last call. Thinking a proactive recommendation: int8 quantized canary + split routing for low-confidence tokens to the current fp16 model. Need engineering & ML feasibility + SRE for rollout plan.

sam_eng: Agree this is worth proposing. Do we have an eval set from them to measure quality delta under int8? Also need expected QPS and current batch sizes.

adele_cs: They shared a small prompt corpus (30k calls/day typical, 75th pct seq len ~280). I asked them to drop the sample set in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/vespera/onboard/samples.

morgan_ml: I pulled a quick diff on a representative 1k sample earlier — top-1 token accuracy drop looks <= 0.6% on int8 for the prompts we care about. Latency improvement per-token ~18% and cost per-token down ~38% in our staging bench. That said, phone-exactness in a couple conversational prompts showed hallucination risk — need targeted eval.

raj_sre: Routing thoughts: do split routing by route tag + confidence threshold. Example policy we could deploy as a canary: 
```json
{
  "canary": true,
  "percent": 8,
  "route_rules": [
    {"route":"/nlp/summary","threshold":0.85,"target":"compact-int8"},
    {"route":"/chat/assist","threshold":0.92,"target":"fp16-primary"}
  ],
  "rollback_triggers": {"error_rate_pct": 0.5, "latency_p95_increase_ms": 80, "quality_drop_pct": 1.0}
}
```
We can wire the canary into their dedicated pool and enable request tracing for every canary request.

sam_eng: For deployment: propose staged canary 5% -> 15% over 48h if metrics stable. Metric checks: cost per-request, p50/p95 latency, user-facing error count, and a small offline quality sweep every 2h using the 500-sample golden set. Automation: if quality_drop_pct > 0.8 for two runs, auto rollback.

morgan_ml: I'll prepare the golden set eval and a small heuristic for hallucination detection (named-entity mismatch + repetition score). Also recommend prompting nudges (add system prompt constraints) to mitigate the hallucination cases we saw.

adele_cs: I’ll package this into an enablement note for the CSM and the renewal lead — include expected monthly $ savings estimate and risk summary. Also want a short playbook for the customer success rep to present to Vespera: impact, rollback plan, timeline.

onboarding-bot: Deployment scheduled: repo: infra/routing-canaries PR opened by sam_eng. Canary ID: canary-vespera-1744300000.

raj_sre: One more ops item — enable sampling logs to S3/secure bucket (redwood-audit/vespera/canary) and grant Vespera read-only access for transparency. Also set alert: if p95 latency > 450ms or quality_drop_pct > 0.8 -> pager to oncall.

sam_eng: I'll create the rollout PR with the policy above and the automation checks. tagging @morgan_ml for the eval hook. ETA: PR today, canary tomorrow AM if everyone signs off.

adele_cs: Great — I'll sync with the renewal manager and the customer tomorrow. Adding action items: 1) morgan: golden set + hallucination detector, 2) sam: PR + automation checks, 3) raj: logging + alerts + access, 4) adele: customer note + renewal brief.

morgan_ml: On it. Will post eval results in thread when ready.

sam_eng: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/8921 — please review.

adele_cs: Thanks team :pray: — aiming to present a low-risk, cost-saving path to Vespera before renewal call next week.
